name: 18966 · Southampton, PA
findings: ZIP 18966 (Southampton) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18966 (Southampton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
